title: God's Plan — physical side (Isaac) and spiritual side (yeshua)
summary: Two-column slide titled God's Plan. Under Physical: if Isaac is sacrificed, no physical side of God's plan can occur. Under Spiritual: if yeshua is not sacrificed, no spiritual side of God's plan can occur.

text.text: If Isaac is Sacrificed, No Physical Side of God’s Plan can occur.
If yeshua is not Sacrificed, No Spiritual Side of God’s Plan can occur.

uncertain: The small Star of David over Physical and cross over Spiritual are decorative OT/NT markers, not transcribed. Colour meanings (G-o-d letters in blue/red/gold) not stated.
